show.description:
Shehzada Bina Taj Ka is a high-voltage corporate revenge drama about betrayal, greed, and comeback.
It's story of Akshay Sethi, a powerful businessman, who gets betrayed by his wife Kawya and business partner Nishant, they snatch his company and publicly humiliate him. Thrown out of his own empire, Akshay vows revenge and returns stronger to expose the conspirators and reclaim his legacy. Watch Now.
